Red synthetic fabric wallet, folded into three parts, with black lining. Wallet has black Velcro closure and reinforced edges in red nylon and red stitching. Wallet front has faux-leather patch with "Barack Obama" in black lettering; patch sewn to wallet in black stitching. Interior of wallet in plastic and vinyl, folded over various pockets. Card from UNO board game inserted into one pocket, paper telephone index (24 pages) loosely inserted into bottom fold. Index has color portrait of Hatem Trabelsi on front and Didier Drogba on back.

This collection documents the extraordinary cultural outpouring of celebratory materials from across the continent of Africa.  They represent Africa’s pride in, ownership of and hopefulness for the candidacy and presidency of Barack Obama.
